user.title: Choose your city
user.description: Cineville shows screenings in the participating cinemas of this city.

venues.title: Choose cinemas
venues.description: Which cinemas in {city} should be included? If you keep all of them selected, cinemas that join Cineville later are added automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the Cineville login: {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The Cineville login of **{name}** has expired. Enter that account's email address; Cineville will then email a code.

reauth_code.title: Enter the code
reauth_code.description: Cineville has emailed a code to **{email}**. Enter it here.

reauth_manual.title: Renew the Cineville login: {name}
reauth_manual.description:
Cineville's login page looks different than expected, so this time it works manually.

1. [Open the Cineville login]({url}) and log in with your email address and the code Cineville sends you.
2. You end up on a blank page. That's expected. Press **Ctrl+U** (view page source) and find the line with `name="code"`.
3. Copy the text inside `value="…"` and paste it below (pasting the whole line works too).

The code is valid for about 5 minutes and only works with this link. This is easiest on a computer.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Cineville. Try again later.
error.invalid_code: That doesn't look like a code.
error.login_failed: The code was not accepted (expired, already used, or from another link). Please use the new link above.
error.wrong_account: That was a different Cineville account. Please log in as {name} (new link above).
error.invalid_email: Cineville didn't accept this email address.
error.invalid_otp: The code is wrong or has expired. Please try again.
error.login_page_changed: Cineville's login page looks different than expected. Please use “Add an account manually”.
error.no_account: There's no Cineville account for this email address yet; Cineville was about to create a new one. Please use the address of your existing Cineville account.

abort.already_configured: This city is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Cineville. Try again later.
